issue.title: Opt-in unlabel of the Gmail bob label after a verified bob gmail pull

task_type_fields.proposal: An opt-in `gmail.pull` setting that removes the `bob` label from a thread after `bob gmail pull` has verifiably saved it and filed its task in gmail_inbox.md, so the phone's `bob` label view stays a to-file queue instead of growing forever.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Deferred by plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 (epic bob-cli-hg). It needs the broader gmail.modify scope and a Gmail mutation, while the epic's invariant I1 kept Gmail the system of record with no label, archive, read-state, or trash changes; pull is read-only and idempotent by thread id today.

issue.creation_reason: Filed by the bob-cli-hg land agent: plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 lists this as a deferred follow-up to file once the Gmail epic lands.
